answer: Audit the grading graph itself: log who grades whom and how, then flag clusters that score each other to the summit while scoring outsiders into the umber-dark low end. Honest graders judge on merit, so their favorable scores scatter across unrelated authors. A collusion ring betrays itself by reciprocity: its high grades flow in a tight loop back to its own, a raven-black knot in an even weave. Detection needs no content analysis; the asymmetry between in-group generosity and out-group severity is the tell, because boosting its own IS the farm's signature.
